title: 踢給你看
subject: a sophomore girl in a university taekwondo club at the September club fair, losing the sign-up race to the judo club's booth next door, where the club with fewer names on its sheet at five o'clock gives up the Wednesday-night slot in the shared basement dojo, until she calls the hundred-kilo judo captain over to hold a board at head height, clips his thumb with the first spinning back kick, splits the board with the second, and wins forty-one to forty, the last name on her sheet being his
caption: Mandarin nu-metal in the turn-of-the-millennium rap-metal style. Down-tuned seven-string guitars chugging bouncy, syncopated riffs with sudden palm-muted stops, a clanky slapped bass doubling the riff, a dry, thudding drum kit with a heavy groove kick and a half-time crash on the chorus, and a DJ scratching a turntable between lines. Thick, dry, mid-heavy band mix with the guitars spread wide. Female voice, a low gritty alto, half-rapped in tight staccato verses and belted with a raw edge on the chorus. 98 BPM, C-sharp minor. Cocky, fierce and funny. No metalcore screams or breakdowns, no djent, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no pop-punk speed, no glossy pop-rock chorus.
lyrics:
[Intro - down-tuned riff and turntable scratches]

[Verse 1]
九月開學 社團博覽會
我們的攤位 剛好在柔道社隔壁
他們社長 把人摔在軟墊上 碰的一聲
整條路的新生 全部擠過去看

[Pre-Chorus]
說好五點收攤 數報名表
簽得少的那一社 禮拜三的道場讓出來

[Chorus]
轉身 後踢 踢給你看
我們這張表 才三個名字
柔道社長 你過來幫我拿木板
拿高一點 拿穩一點 不要躲

[Verse 2]
他一百公斤 笑著走過來
兩手抓著木板 舉到跟他頭一樣高
新生拿著珍奶 圍成一圈
學長在後面小聲問 妳確定喔

[Bridge - riff drops out, kick drum only, half-spoken vocal]
第一腳 踢到他的大拇指
他叫了一聲 整圈的人都在笑
第二腳 換我喊一聲

[Chorus]
轉身 後踢 踢給你看
木板裂成兩半 掉在他腳邊
新生一個接一個 排到我們桌前
柔道社長 還在甩他的大拇指

[Outro - riff, last chord ringing]
五點收攤 四十一比四十
最後一個簽名的 是柔道社社長
